entries.en: Citadel: Schells the Gambler
Schells is outside Flux in the Upper Wards. Speak to him if you want to help.
Speak to Schells
You were able to run scans on the gambling machines in Flux and gather enough data for Schells. He seemed very excited by your findings.
Citadel: Schells has his Data
Doran, the proprietor of Flux, caught you using Schells' scanner and confiscated it. Schells was understandably distressed by the news.
Citadel: Schells' Scanner is Taken
You decided to give Schells scanner to Doran. Schells was understandably upset, but at least he won't be cheating any more.
Citadel: Schells' Scanner Given Away
Schells gave you his scanning device. Go to Flux in the Upper Wards and use the gambling machines at least five times. Don't get caught.
Scan the Machines
Go to find Schells outside Flux in the Upper Wards and tell him that Doran confiscated his scanning device.
Speak to Schells outside Flux in the Upper Wards and let him know you gave his scanning device to Doran.
You scanned the machines five times. Return the scanner to Schells outside Flux in the Upper Wards before you get caught.
Schells' Scanner
The Asari Consort, Sha'ira, has asked you to speak to General Septimus. She's concerned that this former client is spreading false accusations and could damage her reputation.
Citadel: Asari Consort

Septimus has apologized to Sha'ira and Xeltan has ceased his petition. To show her gratitude the Consort rewarded you with an oddly shaped trinket. It appears to be of Prothean design, but doesn't seem to have any purpose beyond sentimental value.
Septimus has apologized to Sha'ira. She is very thankful for all you did to help her.
The general is at Chora's Den in the Lower Wards. Ask him to stop spreading rumors about the Consort.
Speak with Gen. Septimus
Go to Sha'ira at the Consort's Chambers in the Presidium and let her know you've spoken to General Septimus.
Speak with Sha'ira
UNC: Listening Post Alpha
UNC: Listening Post Theta

The data you found at Listening Post Theta indicates that a supply ship came from Depot Sigma-23 in the Gorgon system just before the attacks on Listening Posts Alpha and Theta. That supply depot is likely where this rachni infestation originated.
UNC: Depot Sigma-23

You've cleared the supply depot of the rachni that had infested it. It might be worthwhile to look around for evidence of who was experimenting on the rachni, but the immediate danger has passed for the moment.
You've cleared the base of rachni and discovered the identity of the group that let them get free. It appears to be an organization known as Cerberus.
You've cleared the base of rachni and discovered that this was another of Cerberus's secret experiments. At least they won't be breeding rachni again anytime soon.
UNC: Asari Diplomacy

You've killed an asari mercenary named Dahlia Dantius. According to a datapad found on Dahlia's body, her sister Nassana is a diplomat on the Citadel. Dahlia was evidently blackmailing Nassana by threatening to reveal her own existence and ruin Nassana's career. Nassana will want to hear the news that her sister is dead.
Dahlia's Datapad
You have destroyed the geth transmitter. Zhu's Hope is safe from the immediate threat of the geth.
Vehicle Minigun
Vehicle Cannon
Vehicle Shields
Vehicle Plating
Vehicle Sensors
All combat vehicles include a coaxially-mounted rapid-fire minigun for antipersonnel suppression.
The main cannon is primarily used against vehicles and other hard targets, though it has some anti-personnel utility.
Vehicles fit kinetic barriers similar to those in infantry body armor.
Most combat vehicles are designed with replaceable modular armor that eases repairs and modifications.
Vehicles can be equipped with a variety of mission-specific sensor suites.

Helena Blake, a high-ranking member of a criminal cartel, has asked you to eliminate two of her unpleasant compatriots. Their bases are located in the Han and Dis systems. After eliminating them, meet Ms. Blake in the Fortuna system for a reward.
UNC: Hostile Takeover
You eliminated the crimelords, enabling Helena Blake to take power. Blake has promised that under her leadership, the gang will now restrict itself to smuggling and other "victimless" crimes.
You eliminated the crimelords, and then took down Helena Blake herself to completely destroy the gang.
You eliminated the two rival crimelords and convinced Helena Blake to disband the gang altogether.
The two crimelords are located in the Han System of the Gemini Sigma cluster and in the Dis System of the Hades Gamma cluster. Eliminate both of them.
Eliminate Crimelords
The two crimelords are located in the Han System of the Gemini Sigma cluster and in the Dis System of the Hades Gamma cluster. You've killed the first, now eliminate the second.
Finish Crimelords
Go to the Fortuna system in the Horse Head Nebula and meet Helena Blake to claim your reward.
Meet Helena Blake
Fanatical biotics in the Hades Gamma cluster have kidnapped the chairman of the Parliament Subcommittee on Transhuman Studies and are holed up in a derelict freighter in the Farinata System.
UNC: Hostage
You boarded the freighter and took down the biotics, saving Chairman Burns in the process.
You boarded the freighter and took down the biotics. Chairman Burns died in the course of the fight.
You boarded the freighter and convinced the biotic fanatics to surrender peacefully. Chairman Burns has promised to re-examine his decision regarding payments to L2s in the wake of the kidnapping.
Find the freighter in Farinata System of the Hades Gamma cluster and make your way to the biotics on board.
Board Freighter

Throw
Projects a mass effect field powerful enough to hurl objects and enemies caught in the area of effect out of the way.

Each point spent increases the strength of Throw, knocking targets farther and inflicting greater damage

Lift
Projects a sphere of powerful contra-gravity
Any object or creature caught in the area of effect will be lifted into the air. Enemies will be temporarily immobilized until they fall back to the ground.

Each point spent increases duration of Lift.

Warp
Projects a powerful mass effect field that wreaks havoc on a subatomic level.
Weakens armor and inflicts damage over time on enemies caught in the area of effect.

Each point spent increases the duration of Warp.

Singularity
Projects a sphere of dark energy that creates an intense mass effect field.
Nearby enemies and objects will be drawn into the singularity, unable to escape its gravitational pull.

Each point spent in this ability increases the radius of the singularity.

Barrier
Bolsters your kinetic shields with a mass effect field that can absorb a massive amount of damage
Attacks that penetrate shields will also penetrate this barrier

Each point spent increases the strength and duration of the barrier.

Stasis
Creates a powerful mass effect field that immobilizes a single target

Each point spent increases the duration of stasis.

Damping

Shuts down enemy tech and biotic abilties

The distress call was a trap set by the geth. Escape before the med ship self-destructs and takes you with it.
